People: Aleksandr Sergeevich Pushkin (other, Wikidata Q7200), died 1837; Gavriil Romanovich Derzhavin (other, Wikidata Q270275), died 1816. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Pushkin, Aleksandr Sergeevich, 1799-1837 [Contributor]; Derzhavin, Gavriil Romanovich, 1743-1816 [Contributor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Bakchesarian fountain, Philadelphia, H.C. Sherman, 1976, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bakchesarianfountain. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 97%, 81% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Aleksandr Sergeevich Pushkin, Gavriil Romanovich Derzhavin, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
